text: Current FolderTreeProperties follows folderRenamed and rekeys the old folder URI and descendants. A slash boundary avoids moving test1 while renaming test. Identical URIs are skipped before copy/delete. After saving, folder-color-changed makes rows reread the store. Current browser_folderColorPersistence covers parent/child rename, refused rename, IMAP move by rename, old-key removal and shared-name-prefix sibling. This is later accepted context for291, not code added in291; source tests were read but not run.
title: Rekey stored folder colors on a successful URI change with a path boundary
